name: Kettlebell Alternating Bent-Over Row
steps: Stand hip-width apart with a kettlebell in each hand and your knees slightly bent.
Hinge at your hips and let the bells hang below your shoulders with your palms facing each other.
Pull one kettlebell back toward your hip while keeping the opposite arm extended and your torso completely still.
Lower the first kettlebell smoothly, then row the opposite arm, continuing to alternate sides on each repetition.
tips: Keep your hips and shoulders square to the floor instead of twisting toward the pulling side.
Maintain a strong hip hinge and flat spine throughout the entire set.
